content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms like Stripe often exclude many creators in regions like Kenya, leaving them without effective means to sell digital products. However, adopting a decentralized infrastructure using blockchain technology and platforms like NOWPayments enables you to accept payments in cryptocurrencies without the constraints imposed by conventional banking systems. By utilizing low-fee networks like TRON, your transactions settle in under 60 seconds for mere cents. This ensures you can operate efficiently and without delays, allowing you to focus on creating and selling.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before launching your ebook store, you need a solid foundation. Start with free hosting services like Cloudflare Pages for website deployment. Use Google Sheets or Supabase for order management and storage. Ensure you set up NOWPayments for crypto transactions, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. Familiarize yourself with the basics of GitHub and Cloudflare Workers, as they will be essential for your backend logic. This preparation will streamline your deployment process and set the stage for a successful launch.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To effectively sell ebooks, you must create a seamless payment and delivery pipeline. Begin by integrating NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency payments, which ensures immediate transaction confirmations and minimal fees. Next, establish a connection between your order management system and Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for file delivery, allowing customers to access their purchases instantly. This setup not only guarantees control over your data but also enhances the customer experience by providing swift access to purchased products.
Leverage blockchain to bypass traditional payment barriers.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it’s time to go live. Publish your website on Cloudflare Pages and test all functionalities, including payment processing and product delivery. Ensure that your NOWPayments integration is functioning correctly by making a small purchase yourself. Monitor the transaction to confirm that payments are processed smoothly and that the delivery system works as intended. This step is crucial to ensure everything operates flawlessly for your customers before you start promoting your ebooks.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your initial success, focus on scaling your operations. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which contains all necessary blueprints and templates for expansion. You can add more products to your store and enhance your marketing strategies to reach wider audiences. Consider diversifying your payment options by incorporating additional cryptocurrencies or exploring partnerships with local businesses. This proactive approach will help you grow your customer base while maintaining the infrastructure you’ve established.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Use NOWPayments for instant transactions and low fees.

If you're looking to sell ebooks in Nigeria without PayPal or want to explore digital product stores in Ghana, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It provides everything you need to build and scale your digital commerce infrastructure, ensuring you are not limited by regional payment issues.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept payments in Kenya without Stripe?

You can accept payments in Kenya by using NOWPayments, which supports various cryptocurrencies and has no KYC requirements. This allows you to bypass traditional payment methods and reach a global audience efficiently.
What if I want to sell my ebooks in multiple currencies?

NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, enabling you to sell your ebooks in multiple currencies without needing a traditional bank account. This flexibility broadens your market reach significantly.
How quickly will I receive payment for my ebook sales?

Payments through NOWPayments settle in under 60 seconds using cryptocurrencies like USDT on the TRON network. This quick processing means you have immediate access to your funds without lengthy transaction delays.
Can I manage orders easily with free tools?

Yes, using Google Sheets or Supabase, you can effectively manage orders and track sales without incurring additional costs. These tools provide a straightforward way to organize information and streamline your processes.
What are the benefits of using Cloudflare for my store?

Cloudflare offers robust security, high performance, and free hosting options, making it an ideal choice for your ebook store. It ensures that your website runs smoothly and is protected against potential threats.
